current.label: Normal · live outputs
current.output_domain: Physical station links and outputs as defined by Normal mode

summary: Simulation is set at start, so the station saves this selection, shuts down cleanly and its supervisor restarts it in Testing mode in simulation. Live connections drop for a few seconds and reconnect on their own. The switch is allowed only while the station is idle and is checked again just before the restart.

target.label: Testing · internal flight simulation
